music: Music plays: 'Wind of Change' - Scorpions (Barely audible)
banter: DJ Voice: 'Don't go near the Wall after dark. Just... don't.'
DJ Voice: 'Fresh water available at the Market. For a price that will cost you an arm and a leg. Literally.'
DJ Voice: 'If you see a Super Mutant, run. If you see two, pray.'
DJ Voice: 'Remember, folks: The U-Bahn is not a shelter. It's a tomb.'
DJ Voice: 'Anyone found a working Geiger counter? Mine just screams constantly.'
DJ Voice: 'Berlin: The city that never sleeps, mostly because the radiation keeps you awake.'
DJ Voice: 'Rumor has it The Broker is actually a pre-war toaster with a god complex. Don't tell his bots I said that.'
DJ Voice: 'Mother Renate says eat your greens. I say, check them for teeth first.'
DJ Voice: 'General Von Stahl reminds you: Curfew is at sundown. Violators will be... re-educated.'
DJ Voice: 'Saw the Ghost Train last night. Or maybe it was just the glowing mushrooms kicking in.'

location_based.message: DJ Voice: 'Someone was spotted climbing the Fernsehturm. Crazy or suicidal? You decide.'
DJ Voice: 'Reports of strange lights coming from Museum Island. The Mutants are up to something.'

quest_based.message: DJ Voice: 'Heard some rookie made it to Charlie alive and helped Hans. Maybe there's hope yet.'
DJ Voice: 'If you're new to the zone, head to Checkpoint Charlie. Don't die on the way.'

faction_based.message: Signal Override: 'This is the Iron Ring. The enemy of the state is being hunted. Surrender or die.'
Signal Override: 'Iron Ring command to all units: Assist the Outsider. They are a friend to the cause.'
